description: My name is Justin Fleming, and I am running for PA State Representative in the 105th District. I've been able to have fulfilling employment in public service and advocacy for social work, mental health and children's issues. I've served the citizens of Susquehanna Township as a Commissioner for more than eight years. As state representative, I will listen to your concerns, help you when you need to be connected to services, and fight for your needs on the House Floor.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Friends of Justin Fleming
title: News & Endorsements for Justin Fleming | Candidate for PA State Rep 105th District
